nodes.label: OpenClaw
nodes.description: Personal AI assistant TypeScript monorepo (v2026.4.5). Multi-channel gateway connecting users to AI models via WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, LINE, iMessage, Signal, and more.

nodes.label: GatewayServer
nodes.description: Central HTTP/WebSocket control-plane server. Handles channel routing, auth, config reload, agent dispatch, and control UI. Exposes OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

nodes.label: GatewayProtocol
nodes.description: Typed wire protocol for Gateway control-plane and node communication. Defines schema for Gatewayâ†”client messages.

nodes.label: AgentsSystem
nodes.description: Core AI inference subsystem containing the pi-embedded runner, sub-agent orchestration, tool policy pipeline, system prompt construction, and model catalog.

nodes.label: PiEmbeddedRunner
nodes.description: Primary AI inference loop that executes model calls, handles streaming replies, compaction, tool-call dispatch, and session lifecycle for each conversation turn.

nodes.label: SubAgentSystem
nodes.description: Orchestrates spawning, lifecycle, registry, and depth-limiting of parallel sub-agents within a session. Enables multi-agent task delegation.

nodes.label: SkillsSystem
nodes.description: Loads, installs, and injects skill definitions (SKILL.md files) into the agent system prompt. Supports workspace skills, bundled skills, and contrib skills.

nodes.label: ToolsSystem
nodes.description: Manages tool definitions, exec approvals (SafeBin), bash process registry, tool policy pipeline, and tool-loop detection for agent tool use.

nodes.label: ModelCatalog
nodes.description: Discovers, validates, and caches available models across all providers. Handles model aliases, fallback chains, auth profiles, and provider-specific model IDs.

nodes.label: ChannelsLayer
nodes.description: Shared channel abstractions: config, session management, reply prefixes, allowlists, draft-stream controls, mention gating, and channel plugin registry.

nodes.label: LINEChannel
nodes.description: LINE Messaging API integration: webhook handler, bot message processing, Flex templates, rich menus, reply chunking, and exec approval flow specific to LINE.

nodes.label: DiscordChannel
nodes.description: Discord bot integration: guild and DM message handling, component registry, voice messages, slash commands, draft streaming, and Pluralkit support.

nodes.label: TelegramChannel
nodes.description: Telegram Bot API integration: polling and webhook modes, inline buttons, model selection buttons, voice, group access policy, and native command menu.

nodes.label: WhatsAppChannel
nodes.description: WhatsApp channel integration: outbound target resolution, message normalization. Uses web provider plugin for actual WhatsApp connectivity.

nodes.label: SlackChannel
nodes.description: Slack integration: Block Kit message formatting, threading, OAuth token handling, modal metadata, and streaming mode for long responses.

nodes.label: SignalChannel
nodes.description: Signal messenger integration for private, end-to-end encrypted messaging channel support.

nodes.label: iMessageChannel
nodes.description: iMessage integration for macOS/iOS-native messaging via BlueBubbles or direct AppleScript bridge.

nodes.label: WebChatChannel
nodes.description: Built-in WebChat channel providing a browser-based chat UI served by the gateway. Supports streaming and authentication.

nodes.label: MCPSystem
nodes.description: Model Context Protocol server integration: channel bridge, tool dispatch, and channel-aware MCP server for exposing OpenClaw tools to external MCP clients.

nodes.label: PluginsSystem
nodes.description: Plugin discovery, manifest validation, registry, lifecycle hooks, and dynamic loader. Enables first-party and third-party channel/provider extension via openclaw.plugin.json.

nodes.label: PluginSDK
nodes.description: Public plugin contract surface exported as openclaw/plugin-sdk. Defines channel contracts, provider entry points, sandbox, and core types for third-party plugins.

nodes.label: MemorySystem
nodes.description: Vector embedding store using SQLite-vec. Supports semantic search, hybrid search with MMR, temporal decay, workspace file indexing, and multi-backend embeddings (OpenAI, Voyage, Gemini).

nodes.label: RoutingSystem
nodes.description: Session key derivation, account-to-agent binding, and inbound message routing logic that maps channel messages to the correct agent session.

nodes.label: SessionsSystem
nodes.description: Session storage, transcript management, file repair, write-locking, session slug generation, and session-level config patching.

nodes.label: ConfigSystem
nodes.description: Full configuration load, merge, legacy migration, env variable substitution, includes scanning, runtime overrides, and write-back. Central source of truth for all runtime settings.

nodes.label: ConfigTypes
nodes.description: Comprehensive TypeScript type definitions for all config keys: channels, agents, models, hooks, sandbox, skills, tools, providers, and more.

nodes.label: ZodSchemas
nodes.description: Zod validation schemas for all configuration domains. Used to validate user-provided config and generate schema help text.

nodes.label: openclaw.prod.json5
nodes.description: Production configuration file for the deployed OpenClaw instance. Contains channel credentials, agent defaults, model settings, and SafeBin exec profiles.

nodes.label: exec-approvals.prod.json
nodes.description: Production exec approval list mapping pre-approved safe commands for agent bash tool use without interactive confirmation.

nodes.label: SecurityLayer
nodes.description: Audit logging, DM policy enforcement, dangerous tool detection, external content scanning, SafeBin exec policy, skill scanner, and Windows ACL checks.

nodes.label: ProvidersLayer
nodes.description: Provider-specific auth helpers: GitHub Copilot token exchange, Google Gemini shared utilities, Qwen portal OAuth. Consumed by the model auth system in agents.

nodes.label: AnthropicProvider
nodes.description: Anthropic Claude integration via the pi-embedded SDK. Handles Claude API calls, streaming, token usage, prompt cache stability, and auth profile rotation.

nodes.label: OpenAIProvider
nodes.description: OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint and responses API implementation. Supports OpenAI models and acts as a compatibility layer for third-party OpenAI-API-compatible providers.

nodes.label: TTSSystem
nodes.description: Text-to-speech pipeline for voice output across channels. Supports multiple TTS backends for macOS, iOS, and cloud-based speech synthesis.

nodes.label: MediaSystem
nodes.description: Media processing pipeline: image/audio/video downloads, attachment handling, media understanding, and link understanding for enriching agent context.

nodes.label: BrowserTools
nodes.description: Headless browser integration for web scraping, screenshot, and page interaction tools available to the agent via the tools system.

nodes.label: CanvasHost
nodes.description: Live Canvas rendering host that serves a controllable interactive canvas surface connected to the agent session for rich visual output.

nodes.label: AutoReply
nodes.description: Auto-reply engine with templating support for generating automated responses based on config-defined rules and templates.

nodes.label: HooksSystem
nodes.description: Event hook pipeline allowing plugins and config to register callbacks on lifecycle events: agent start, message, tool call, compaction, session, and LLM events.

nodes.label: CronSystem
nodes.description: Scheduled task runner for periodic operations such as memory sync, session cleanup, and channel health checks driven by cron expressions in config.

nodes.label: CLISystem
nodes.description: Command-line interface built with the program builder. Provides commands for gateway management, onboarding, session control, config editing, and diagnostics.

nodes.label: OnboardingWizard
nodes.description: Interactive terminal wizard (openclaw onboard) guiding new users through gateway setup, channel configuration, model selection, and workspace initialization.

nodes.label: InfraLayer
nodes.description: Infrastructure utilities: dotenv loading, port management, binary ensurance, runtime version guard, error formatting, and path environment setup.

nodes.label: AuthSystem
nodes.description: Gateway authentication: device auth, connection auth, startup auth, HTTP auth helpers, rate limiting, and role/method scope policy enforcement.

nodes.label: ControlUI
nodes.description: Web-based control plane UI served by the gateway. Provides real-time config editing, session management, channel status, and model switching.

nodes.label: SandboxSystem
nodes.description: Execution sandbox for agent tool calls: path safety, Docker exec args, sandbox config merging, workspace path resolution, and policy enforcement.

nodes.label: SharedUtils
nodes.description: Shared utility library providing text chunking, webhook path helpers, JSON store, file locking, temp paths, and status helpers used across all modules.

nodes.label: TypeDeclarations
nodes.description: TypeScript ambient type declarations for third-party packages lacking types: node-pty, napi-rs-canvas, node-llama-cpp, osc-progress, and others.

nodes.label: ACPLayer
nodes.description: Anthropic Claude Platform integration layer for advanced provider features and token exchange flows specific to Anthropic's hosted services.

nodes.label: PairingSystem
nodes.description: Mobile device pairing over WebSocket for iOS/Android client connections to the gateway, supporting both LAN ws:// and Tailscale wss:// transports.

nodes.label: LINE API
nodes.description: External LINE Messaging API used by channel_line for webhook verification, message sending, rich menus, and Flex message templates.

nodes.label: Discord API
nodes.description: External Discord REST and Gateway API used by channel_discord for bot connectivity, guild management, and real-time message events.

nodes.label: Telegram Bot API
nodes.description: External Telegram Bot API used by channel_telegram for polling/webhook message delivery, media downloads, and native command registration.
